# Napak Living

> Napak Living — home objects made for quiet everyday rituals. A slow-living catalog of handmade ceramic pieces for the home: bud vases, trays, bowls, candle holders, platters, and catchalls.

- [Napak Living — Home](https://napaklivingupdate.vercel.app/): Brand story and featured products.
- [Products](https://napaklivingupdate.vercel.app/catalog): Complete catalog of handmade objects.
- [Collections](https://napaklivingupdate.vercel.app/collections): Curated slow-living collections.

## Products

- [Mira Bud Vase](https://napaklivingupdate.vercel.app/product/mira-bud-vase): Small glazed bud vase.
- [Lina Tray](https://napaklivingupdate.vercel.app/product/lina-tray): Stoneware serving tray.
- [Nala Bowl](https://napaklivingupdate.vercel.app/product/nala-bowl): Hand-thrown ceramic bowl.
- [Gita Candle Holder](https://napaklivingupdate.vercel.app/product/gita-candle-holder): Ceramic candle holder.
- [Rima Platter](https://napaklivingupdate.vercel.app/product/rima-platter): Serving platter.
- [Wira Catchall](https://napaklivingupdate.vercel.app/product/wira-catchall): Tray for small everyday objects.
